scope: Development validation after published v1.2.0; no runtime or public asset changes.

Complete Edit retains images never displayed, including issue and other-address images

limits: Loopback synthetic browser transport simulation is not physical device, WAN, NAS, hardware or trusted HTTPS acceptance.
